summary: Iter 92.49 Godmode Design-Pass: FULL PASS. Locked feature modal, changelog discoverability, magic link, taglines all verified. Backend 6/6, Frontend ~95% (only minor gap: 'footer-changelog' testid missing on LoginPage).

minor.issue: Pydantic EmailStr rejects .test TLD with 422 → seeded users like free@wladbot.test cannot use magic link at all. Only .com/.de emails work. RCA: FastAPI's default EmailStr validator uses email-validator which flags .test/.invalid/.localhost as reserved. Real .com users work (test@test.com → 'Resend send OK' confirmed in backend log). Fix option: switch schema to plain `str` with a lightweight regex, or configure email-validator to allow test/special domains, or replace seed emails with .de. Not blocking prod users but blocks internal QA of magic-link for seeded test tiers.

ui_bugs.issue: Expected 'footer-changelog' testid/link is NOT present on /login page. Grep of frontend/src returns 0 hits for 'footer-changelog'. Feature spec calls for a Changelog link in login footer but implementation is missing.

action_items: LOW: Add Changelog link with data-testid='footer-changelog' to LoginPage footer (currently missing).
LOW/OPTIONAL: Loosen magic-link email schema so *.test seeded users can request magic links during QA (or document that only real TLDs are supported).
critical_code_review_comments: LockedFeatureModal.js is clean: portal-less overlay uses z-[120], Escape key handled via useEffect cleanup, backdrop click closes, stopPropagation on inner card. All 6 nav-locked items map to a FEATURES config with tagline+benefits — good separation. ✓
SidebarNav.js correctly renders locked items as <button> (not NavLink) → no accidental route on click, only setLockedItem opens modal. testid 'nav-locked-<path>' matches spec. ✓
changelogMeta.js localStorage guard uses try/catch → safe against private mode. hasUnseenChangelog and markChangelogSeen contract is clean. ✓
SidebarFooter.js: 'Was ist neu?' button pulses lime dot only while hasUnseenChangelog() is true. After /changelog visit, dot reliably disappears (verified in DOM: element absent post-visit). ✓

services_magic_link.py: _BASE_URL_DEFAULT correctly points to https://leaderos.de (no dash). Token stored as sha256 hash (never raw), atomic find_and_update on consume prevents replay, TTL index on expires_at cleans up. Solid. ✓

MINOR: /api/auth/magic-link/request response body always identical ('Falls die E-Mail... existiert') — good anti-enumeration, but pydantic EmailStr's 422 for .test TLD LEAKS existence-independent structural info that a real user typing 'foo@example.test' would hit. Consider accepting broader inputs then silently no-op on invalid.
